name: Drafter: builds context, calls AI router, checks JSON, saves draft

nodes.name: Called by a workflow
nodes.notes: Input: userId and reminderId (from the scheduler, M7). Nothing else: every fact in the draft comes from the database.

nodes.name: Draft in the app
nodes.notes: The app builds the facts, runs the AI router (local first, then the cloud fallback if allowed, then the fixed template), checks the draft (schema, pay link, no invented amounts, Tier 3 legal gating) and saves it on the reminder. Safe to re-run: a reminder that already has a draft is left alone. Returns { status, draft?, message }. Local dev URL; change it for a deployed app.
